title: Binance Futures Will List Coin-Margined Quarterly 0325 Futures Contracts
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will list BTC, ETH, BNB, ADA, LINK, BCH, XRP, DOT, and LTC Coin-Margined Quarterly 0325 Contracts within the next few hours after the Coin-Margined Quarterly 0924 Contracts expire and settle at 2021-09-24 08:00 AM (UTC).  Notes: Users are only allowed to close their positions or place Reduce Only orders and are not allowed to open any new positions 10 minutes prior to delivery. For further information, please refer to  Delivery and Settlement of Quarterly Futures .  Risk Warning : Futures trading carries substantial risk and the possibility of both significant profits and losses. Past gains are not indicative of future returns. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of extreme price movements. The information here should not be regarded as financial or investment advice from Binance. All trading strategies are used at your discretion and your own risk. Binance will not be liable to you for any loss that might arise from your use of Futures. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our  Responsible Trading resource page .  Thanks for your support!
